lines.speaker: CORVIN
lines.text: The tide comes in twice a day at Mordida. Once with the fish. Once with everybody else.

lines.speaker: CORVIN
lines.text: Half of it's mud. The other half is evidence with poor boundaries.

lines.speaker: CORVIN
lines.text: I've been in it. I'm not going back in it.

lines.speaker: CORVIN
lines.text: Everything else looks like mine, which is somehow worse.

lines.speaker: CORVIN
lines.text: Not yet. Give it six days.

lines.speaker: CORVIN
lines.text: Whole town's built through a dead thing's chest and nobody finds that remarkable but me.

lines.text: She wrote my name back in. Didn't say anything about it.

lines.speaker: NARRATION
lines.text: Water pools on Sabine's floor. She crosses through it like it isn't there.

lines.speaker: NARRATION
lines.text: Two fingers to the inside of his wrist. Four seconds. Nothing. Her hand stays.

lines.speaker: SABINE
lines.text: Don't make me say a thing badly when I'm doing it correctly.

lines.speaker: SABINE
lines.text: Get out of my office, Corvin.
